description: baseline
Correctness-only experiment: score the final position of right-aligned histories instead of count_nonzero-1. Preserve the baseline architecture and hyperparameters to measure the indexing fix alone.

Fix the right-aligned scoring index as a correctness change, and reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.1 as a regularization experiment. Less noise across eight residual blocks may improve fitting within the fixed training protocol; gains cannot be attributed solely to dropout because this attempt also fixes indexing.

Fix right-aligned scoring as a correctness change and reduce the backbone to four residual blocks with dilations 1,2,4,8. The resulting 61-position receptive field may capture useful recent interactions with less overfitting and easier optimization. Any improvement combines the indexing fix and the depth change.

Fix right-aligned scoring as a correctness change and remove absolute position embeddings as an architectural simplification. Causal convolutions already encode relative order; removing absolute positions may improve transfer from training positions to the final inference position. This combined attempt cannot isolate the architectural contribution.

Retain the corrected final-position scorer and mask padding within each residual block, including between its two convolutions. LayerNorm offsets and convolution biases otherwise create artificial padding activations that later convolutions can consume. This architectural padding-handling experiment may improve short-history representations without changing depth or hyperparameters.

Increase hidden width from 64 to 128 while retaining this trajectory's dropout of 0.1 and corrected final-position scorer. Larger item embeddings and convolution channels may capture more diverse movie preferences; this is a capacity experiment with no additional correctness change.

Reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.1 within this trajectory's four-block incumbent. The shallower model may need less regularization and benefit from cleaner training signals. Preserve its architecture and existing right-aligned scoring correction to isolate the dropout change.

Scale each residual convolution branch by 0.5 in this trajectory's position-free incumbent. Smaller residual updates may preserve item identity and stabilize optimization across eight blocks. This is an architectural experiment; retain the existing final-position scoring correction and all training hyperparameters.

Reduce learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005 while preserving the incumbent architecture and corrected final-position scorer. The previous padding-mask experiment did not improve HR@10; smaller Adam updates may improve convergence and ranking without adding model complexity. This is an optimization experiment with no new correctness change.

Remove absolute position embeddings from this trajectory's 64-channel, dropout-0.1 incumbent after increasing width failed to improve HR@10. Causal convolutions retain relative order, while removing absolute positions may reduce dependence on training positions and simplify the model. Preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this attempt makes only an architectural change.

Increase kernel size from 3 to 5 in the four-block incumbent, expanding its theoretical receptive field from 61 to 121 positions without increasing depth. The dropout reduction only tied HR@10, so retain dropout 0.2 and test whether wider causal context improves ranking. Preserve the existing final-position scoring correction; this is an architectural experiment.

Replace the successful fixed residual multiplier of 0.5 with one learned scalar per block initialized to 0.5. This preserves the incumbent's initial residual strength while allowing training to adjust how much each dilation contributes, adding only eight parameters. Retain the position-free backbone, all training constants, and the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is an architectural refinement.

Increase dropout from 0.2 to 0.3 while retaining the successful learning rate of 0.0005. Stronger regularization may improve generalization across eight residual blocks after the padding-mask change failed. Preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is solely a regularization experiment.

Introduce Adam weight decay of 0.0001 into the unchanged 64-channel, dropout-0.1 incumbent. Increasing width and removing positions both failed, so test whether modest parameter regularization improves ranking without architectural complexity. Retain the existing final-position scoring correction; no new correctness change is proposed.

Reduce learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005 in the four-block incumbent. Lower dropout only tied HR@10 and wider kernels degraded it, so retain the original architecture and regularization while testing finer optimization updates. Preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is solely an optimization experiment.

Reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.1 in the position-free backbone with learned residual scales. The successful residual attenuation may permit less dropout, improving the signal used to learn convolution features and block contributions. Keep learned scales initialized to 0.5 and preserve the existing final-position scoring correction; this is a regularization experiment.

Scale each residual branch by a fixed 0.5 while retaining learning rate 0.0005 and dropout 0.2. Higher dropout only tied the incumbent, so test whether smaller convolution updates improve optimization and preserve useful item identity across eight blocks. This is an architectural experiment; retain the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005 while retaining the successful weight decay of 0.0001, dropout 0.1, and 64-channel architecture. Finer Adam updates may improve ranking after weight decay improved this trajectory's incumbent. This is solely an optimization experiment; preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Introduce weight decay of 0.0001 while retaining the four-block architecture, dropout 0.2, and successful learning rate 0.0005. Lower dropout and wider kernels failed to improve this trajectory, so test modest parameter regularization without additional architectural complexity. Preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is a regularization experiment.

Reduce learning rate from 0.001 to 0.0005 in the position-free backbone with learned residual scales. Lower dropout only tied HR@10, so retain dropout 0.2 and test whether finer updates improve joint optimization of embeddings, convolutions, and block contributions. This is solely an optimization experiment; retain the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Replace the successful fixed residual multiplier with a learned scalar per block initialized to 0.5. This retains the incumbent's initial residual strength while allowing each dilation to adjust its contribution, adding only eight parameters. Preserve all training constants and the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is an architectural refinement.

Reduce kernel size from 3 to 2 while retaining eight blocks, dropout 0.1, weight decay 0.0001, and learning rate 0.0005. Increasing width and removing positions failed in this trajectory; narrower causal kernels instead reduce convolution parameters and emphasize recent context, with a 61-position receptive field. This is an architectural experiment that preserves the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Scale each residual branch by a fixed 0.5 in the four-block incumbent. Lower dropout, wider kernels, and weight decay did not improve this trajectory, so test whether attenuating convolution updates preserves useful item identity and improves optimization without adding parameters. Retain learning rate 0.0005 and the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is an architectural experiment.

Reduce learning rate from 0.0005 to 0.00025 after the previous reduction improved this trajectory's HR@10. Finer updates may further improve joint optimization of item embeddings, causal convolutions, and learned residual scales under the fixed protocol. Preserve the position-free architecture, dropout 0.2, and existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is solely an optimization experiment.

Replace GELU with SiLU while preserving the successful fixed 0.5 residual scaling. Learned block scales failed to improve this trajectory; a smoother activation may improve convolution optimization without adding parameters. Keep all hyperparameters and the existing right-aligned scoring correction unchanged; this is an architectural experiment.

Attenuate each residual branch by a fixed factor of 0.5 while retaining the incumbent's kernel size 3, dropout 0.1, and weight decay. Narrower kernels did not improve HR@10; smaller residual updates instead may preserve item identity and stabilize the eight-block backbone without reducing its receptive field. This is an architectural experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce the fixed residual multiplier from 0.5 to 0.25 after residual attenuation improved this trajectory's HR@10. Stronger attenuation may further preserve the item embedding signal while retaining learned causal context in the four-block backbone. Keep all hyperparameters and the existing right-aligned scoring correction unchanged; this is an architectural refinement.

Introduce weight decay of 0.0001 while retaining learning rate 0.0005 and the position-free backbone with learned residual scales. Further reducing learning rate failed, so test whether modest parameter regularization improves generalization without architectural additions. Preserve the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is solely a regularization experiment.

Reduce kernel size from 3 to 2 while retaining eight blocks and fixed residual scaling of 0.5. Learned residual scales and SiLU failed to improve this trajectory; narrower kernels instead reduce parameters and emphasize recent context with a 61-position receptive field. Preserve all other constants and the existing right-aligned scoring correction. This is an architectural experiment.

Increase dropout from 0.1 to 0.15 while retaining the successful learning rate and weight decay. Narrower kernels and residual attenuation did not improve this trajectory; modestly stronger dropout may improve generalization without changing its backbone. This is a regularization experiment, preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Change the four-block dilation schedule from 1,2,4,8 to 1,2,4,16, expanding the theoretical receptive field from 61 to 93 positions without adding parameters. Wider kernels previously degraded HR@10; increasing only the final dilation tests longer context while preserving narrow kernels and successful residual scaling of 0.5. This is an architectural experiment with the existing right-aligned scoring correction retained.

Replace GELU with SiLU in the position-free backbone with learned residual scales. Further learning-rate reduction and weight decay failed to improve this trajectory; a different smooth activation may improve convolution feature learning without adding parameters. Preserve all constants, residual-scale initialization, and the existing right-aligned scoring correction. This is an architectural experiment.

Reduce learning rate from 0.0005 to 0.0003 while retaining the incumbent's fixed residual multiplier of 0.5. Learned scales, SiLU, and narrower kernels failed to improve this trajectory; finer optimization updates may improve ranking without architectural changes. Preserve the existing right-aligned final-position scoring correction; this is solely an optimization experiment.

Remove biases from both causal convolutions in every block while preserving the incumbent's architecture dimensions and training constants. Narrower kernels, residual attenuation, and increased dropout failed to improve HR@10; removing convolution offsets simplifies the backbone and may reduce unhelpful padding-derived signals. This is an architectural experiment, not a correctness fix; retain the existing final-position scorer.

Reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.15 in the four-block incumbent with fixed residual scaling of 0.5. Dropout 0.1 previously tied an earlier parent before learning-rate reduction and residual attenuation; this intermediate rate tests whether the current attenuated backbone benefits from cleaner training signals. Retain all other constants and the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is a regularization experiment.

Replace each learned scalar residual scale with a learned vector of channel scales, all initialized to 0.5. Learned block scales previously improved this trajectory; channel-specific scaling may better balance item identity and contextual features with only 504 additional parameters at the default width and depth. Preserve the position-free causal backbone, all training constants, and the existing right-aligned scoring correction; this is an architectural refinement.

Reduce dropout from 0.2 to 0.15 while retaining fixed residual scaling of 0.5 and learning rate 0.0005. Higher dropout failed and a further learning-rate reduction only tied the incumbent; modestly less dropout may improve feature learning in the attenuated backbone. This is a regularization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce learning rate from 0.0005 to 0.0003 while retaining dropout 0.1 and weight decay 0.0001. The earlier learning-rate reduction improved this trajectory, whereas recent architectural and dropout changes failed; finer updates may improve its current incumbent without adding complexity. This is an optimization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce learning rate from 0.0005 to 0.0003 in the four-block incumbent with fixed residual scaling of 0.5. Stronger residual attenuation, longer context, and reduced dropout failed to improve this parent; finer optimization may improve ranking while retaining the successful architecture and regularization. This is solely an optimization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce depth from eight to four residual blocks in this trajectory's position-free incumbent, retaining learned scalar residual scales initialized to 0.5. Learning-rate reduction, weight decay, SiLU, and channel-specific scaling failed to improve the current parent; a simpler 61-position receptive field may reduce overfitting and ease optimization. This is an architectural experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction and all other constants.

Introduce weight decay of 0.00001 while retaining the incumbent's learning rate, dropout, and fixed residual scaling. Recent activation, kernel, dropout, and learning-rate changes failed to improve HR@10; mild parameter regularization offers a simple untested direction for this trajectory. This is a regularization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce weight decay from 0.0001 to 0.00003 while retaining learning rate 0.0005 and dropout 0.1. Weight decay helped an earlier parent, but its strength has not been revisited after the successful learning-rate reduction; milder shrinkage may better balance fitting and generalization in the current incumbent. This is a regularization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce learning rate from 0.0003 to 0.0002 while preserving the four-block backbone and fixed residual multiplier of 0.5. Both previous learning-rate reductions improved this trajectory, including the latest attempt; a further modest reduction tests whether finer updates continue to improve ranking. This is solely an optimization experiment preserving the existing right-aligned scoring correction.

Reduce kernel size from 3 to 2 while retaining eight position-free blocks and learned scalar residual scales. Reducing depth failed to improve this trajectory; narrower kernels instead retain all eight learned transformations while reducing convolution parameters and the theoretical receptive field from 121 to 61 positions. This is an architectural experiment preserving all other constants and the existing right-aligned scoring correction.
